Atin Taqifin — an original Aramaic “Meturgeman piyyuṭ” in honor of Mosheh Rabbeinu for Simḥat Torah by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:div.tei:head: Atin Taqifin — an original Aramaic “Meturgeman piyyuṭ” in honor of Mosheh Rabbeinu for Simḥat Torah by Isaac Gantwerk Mayer

tei:lg.tei:l: Mighty signs Moshe did in the eyes of Israel.
Lauded blessings Ṭoviyyah did in the eyes of Jacob.
Great glories Shma’ya did in the eyes of Jeshurun.
Holy matters Yered spoke in the ears of Israel.
Righteous laws Ḥever spoke in the ears of Jacob.
And explicit traditions Yequtiel spoke in the ears of Jeshurun.
Favored merits Avi-Gdor gave in the hands of Israel.
Much freedom Avi-Sokho gave in the hands of Jacob.
Sweet goodness Avi-Zanoaḥ gave in the hands of Jeshurun.
Laudable inheritance Ben-Netan’el led in the hands of Israel.
All to see Moshe did in the eyes of Israel.
